semantics.clock: All sequential updates occur on the positive edge of clk.
semantics.reset: Synchronous active-high reset takes priority and sets all digits to zero on a rising edge. No asynchronous effect.
semantics.count: With reset low, increment by one decimal count on each rising edge; wrap 9999 to 0000.
semantics.enables: Combinational from current q, independent of reset: ena[0] is true when ones=9; ena[1] when ones=tens=9; ena[2] when ones=tens=hundreds=9. They indicate carry for the next non-reset rising edge.
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up value; reset must be clocked before defined counting behavior.

numeric.encoding: Unsigned BCD: q[3:0] ones, q[7:4] tens, q[11:8] hundreds, q[15:12] thousands.
numeric.overflow: Decimal modulo 10000, each enabled digit wraps 9 to 0.
numeric.invalid_states: No behavior required for invalid BCD encodings or before reset.

verification.oracle: Independent integer model increments modulo 10000 and converts to four decimal nibbles.
verification.coverage: Run more than two complete periods; check q and all enables every cycle; exercise reset during counting and while a carry is pending; hold reset across multiple edges.
verification.reset_timing: Toggle reset between clock edges and verify q holds until a positive edge.
verification.execution: Explicit dev_tb top with Icarus -g2012 and matching vvp, finite external and testbench timeouts.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Map ena[0:2] to digits[1:3]; combinational carry predicates of current lower digits, without reset gating, as increment indications.
Unspecified; no added initialization or recovery requirement.
